title: Commit removes a spell copy and its pending action consistently
plain_english: A real frozen-Oracle Opt spell and a synthetic copy of that spell are on the stack with separate action identities.
P0 casts the Commit face of the real frozen-Oracle Commit // Memory targeting the current spell-copy object.
After all players pass, Commit resolves and puts the targeted spell copy second from the top of the modeled library path before synthetic cessation processing.
The action that created the removed spell copy is removed from pending_actions at the same transition.
The original Opt spell and its action remain on the stack and pending until their own legal resolution or countering.

preconditions: an Opt spell object is on the stack
a synthetic spell copy of Opt is above it on the stack
both stack objects have distinct pending action IDs
Commit // Memory is in P0 hand
ordered_operations: cast Commit targeting the spell-copy object
required_assertions: the targeted spell-copy action is absent from pending_actions
Commit's action is absent from pending_actions after resolution
the original Opt action remains pending
the targeted spell-copy object is no longer on the stack
